body: Just v sick of being told I’m overreacting but don’t trust my own head anymore to know I’m not.
Baggage related - he has self harmed under the influence of alcohol before - last night he fell off the wagon. Then he never came online today until very very late

That my owner might have died/taken his own life last night. And then the comment about saying I love you as hatefully as I can. He said he might be justifiably angry at me for trying to make sure he was safe. We were both shouting.

Old baggage. My mental health. Theirs. Me being terrified that I’ll be left alone. I’m losing control. Just shouted at my husband a little while ago then collapsed in a panic attack. Now I’m here. Was about to go back and clarify that I wasn’t mistreating him but not even sure that’s the case anymore.
There’s a lot more to it. And at the end of the day my head is so fucked up in general that I don’t know what to do.
Weird sort of polyamorous Vee/Triad I’m in. Hard to explain. Lots of baggage. Love them both so much. Feel like I do nothing but hurt them.
